annotations.title: Check one name across many extensions

description: Request availability and current quotes for a specific name across supported TLD extensions at once. Give a bare label ('acme') to see acme.com, acme.io, acme.ai... or a full domain ('acme.io') to check that one. Availability, registration prices, and renewal details are returned when supplied, alongside a registrar link. Missing fields stay unconfirmed; confirm final terms at the registrar.

exact_extension.description: Optional. If the name already includes an extension, set true to check only that exact domain instead of expanding across TLDs.

name.description: The name to check. A bare label ('acme') is expanded across many TLDs; a full domain ('acme.io') checks that exact domain.

tlds.description: Optional. Limit to these TLD extensions without the dot (e.g. ['com','co','io']).

name: search_domain
title: Check one name across many extensions
